high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for the Maserati Quattroporte, featuring a sleek, dark blue sedan parked on a wet street. The car is positioned prominently in the foreground, showcasing its elegant design and polished finish. The background includes a wall with a mural depicting two cartoonish figures: one appears to be a donkey or horse, and the other resembles a man wearing a top hat. The mural adds a playful and artistic element to the scene. The text overlay on the image reads: "Luxury, scale and space" "Quattroporte, the original race-bred luxury sedan, since 1963
